intent: Single-line text entry for forms and filters.
useWhen: Collecting short text such as name, email, or search queries
Inside a Field wrapper when label, hint, or error messaging is needed
doNotUseWhen: Choosing from fixed options — use Select or RadioGroup
Standalone labeled forms without Field — you must wire label association yourself

requirements: Must have associated label via Field or aria-label
error state should be described by Field error text

doNot: Do not invent local Input variants
Do not use raw hex in styles
Do not add icons or adornments not in this contract
